text.text_excerpt: We've ordered a couple of the boxes of wine from Independent Caveau and absolutely loved them! We've gotten some new favorite wines, that we had never even heard of, much less tried! I also may have found a new favorite champagne called Effervescence that they picked out! They've got wines from all around the world, so this is NOT the wine shop that's got the same selections you can find anywhere. We FINALLY got around to visiting in person and it was just fantastic! Daily selections of wine by the glass or bottle + daily selections of cheese ! New Zion, Mid City Broadmoor, not sure what to call this budding little area yet, but The Independent Caveau is sure to be an anchor for the growing neighborhood. Located in what I think of as the bermuda triangle connecting broadmoor to central city, this wine bar and shop is everything the area has been missing. A laid back, but sophisticated social gathering spot, for the wine and cheese enthusiast. It's close enough to everything but off the beaten path enough to feel special. We stopped in on a Thursday at opening time to try ALL the wines and a sampling of cheese & charcouterie. Since we've been locked in our house we have ordered from Jim at The Independent Caveau a couple times with great success. Our first order was the "wine box" which is a mixed case curated by Jim and his team. It was a great introduction to both The Independent Caveau and some wines from around the world we never would have found on our own. Since we had such a great experience we've ordered again. You really do get a tailored experience based on your preferences and budget. We went with a whites and rosés theme this time in preparation for the summer heat.
